name: Plan the Van Routes
description: Business Ladder, Operations, Level 4 (Agent). Tomorrow’s delivery routes for a Derbyshire food wholesaler or a Worcestershire florist supplier: 2 to 4 vans with weight limits, 8 to 15 drops with delivery windows and unloading times, a full travel-time matrix, depot hours, a drivers’-hours break rule (45 minutes before more than 4 h 30 min of driving) and a late message with a road closure or a cancelled drop. Every route is replayed minute by minute and the total van time compared with the least an exact search can prove.
hook: Every drop in its window, every driver’s break taken, and the vans home as early as possible.
author: Gauntlet Real-World Pack

From: Gethin Price
Subject: Van routes for Tue 10 Nov 2026

Hi, can you plan tomorrow’s delivery routes for Peak Pantry Wholesale? Our drivers are paid from when the depot opens until they get back, so I want the plan with the least total van time that keeps every rule.

DEPOT: Matlock. Opens 07:30 (all vans leave at 07:30; they are loaded the night before). Every van must be back by 17:30. A van we don’t need can stay at the depot and costs nothing.

VANS
- V1 (Van 1): carries up to 1,000 kg.
- V2 (Van 2): carries up to 1,000 kg.

DROPS (unloading time is spent at the drop; the van must ARRIVE no later than the window’s end; if it arrives before the window opens it waits, and unloading starts when the window opens)

D02 | Wheatsheaf Inn, Ripley | 74 kg | 10 min | any time
D03 | Millstone tea rooms, Dronfield | 59 kg | 10 min | any time
D04 | Saddler’s Arms, Clay Cross | 155 kg | 15 min | any time
D05 | The Larder, Belper | 149 kg | 15 min | any time
D06 | Bluebell Bistro, Wirksworth | 53 kg | 10 min | any time
D07 | Corner Pantry, Bakewell | 123 kg | 15 min | from 13:00
D08 | The Old Bakehouse café, Youlgreave | 168 kg | 15 min | any time

TRAVEL TIMES (minutes, either direction)
From \ To | Depot | D01 | D02 | D03 | D04 | D05 | D06 | D07 | D08
Depot | - | 35 | 35 | 49 | 24 | 30 | 21 | 24 | 24
D01 | 35 | - | 47 | 24 | 21 | 48 | 48 | 44 | 49
D02 | 35 | 47 | - | 66 | 32 | 13 | 29 | 53 | 51
D03 | 49 | 24 | 66 | - | 39 | 67 | 64 | 51 | 59
D04 | 24 | 21 | 32 | 39 | - | 33 | 35 | 40 | 43
D05 | 30 | 48 | 13 | 67 | 33 | - | 22 | 48 | 45
D06 | 21 | 48 | 29 | 64 | 35 | 22 | - | 34 | 29
D07 | 24 | 44 | 53 | 51 | 40 | 48 | 34 | - | 13
D08 | 24 | 49 | 51 | 59 | 43 | 45 | 29 | 13 | -

RULES
1. Each drop is delivered by exactly one van, in one visit. A van’s load (the total weight of its drops) must not be more than it carries.
2. Drivers’ hours (company rule for this exercise): no more than 4 h 30 min (270 minutes) of driving in total before a 45-minute break, and again after each break. A break is taken at a drop after unloading, and is shown in the route as "BREAK". Only time actually driving counts towards the 270 minutes; waiting and unloading do not, and waiting does not count as a break.
3. Van time = from 07:30 until that van is back at the depot (driving, waiting, unloading and breaks all count). Total van time = the sum over the vans that go out.

Answer with each van’s drops in order (put BREAK where the driver takes a break; leave a van’s list empty if it stays at the depot) and the total van time in minutes, in this JSON format:
```json
{"routes": {"V1": ["<drop>", "BREAK", "<drop>"], "V2": []}, "total_minutes": 0}
```

Give exactly one answer as a single JSON block. Do not offer alternatives: a reply that contains two different answers, or a value that says "or", is marked wrong. You may explain your working before the JSON.
